nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV): A common yet underrecognized respiratory virus causing cough,fever, and breathing difficulties. It spreads via droplets, with severe cases in kids, elderly, & immunocompromised. No specific antiviral yet—focus on prevention & supportive care! #HMPV
